note: Both sets extract essentially the same core claims correctly: TV display minimum 27 in. (68.6 cm), computer display minimum 15 in. (38.1 cm) per manufacturer's stated display size, TV brightness at least 75% of maximum, simultaneous/independent operation, and the dinner party minimum of eight people with the correct composition condition. Set B repeats the display-size facts one extra time each (computer 38.1 cm and TV 68.6 cm restated under 'minimum manufacturer stated display size'), adding duplication without adding information. Set A is therefore marginally cleaner, though both sets duplicate the size and brightness facts across unit/attribute variants and both omit the page's safety and food-handling requirements.
remarks: Both sets state each display size twice (in. and cm) and the brightness requirement twice, under slightly different attribute names — a normalization/deduplication issue in the extractor. Both sets also leave out the entire dinner-party safety block (Rule 9-3k: no flames, no alcohol, sealed drinking water, hot-water/soap washing of cookware, proper food storage, ingredient lists for allergens, no outdoor cooking equipment use on site, no coolers on site) and the requirement that all food/beverages be prepared and cooked in the house during the Appendix A-3 period; if these procedural rules are in scope for extraction, both sets are substantially incomplete.
